design_request_loop.purpose: Students get Exo's code-gen on tap to build campaign tools/site, safely.
design_request_loop.gate: EXO BOT is the primary gate — Exo triages and decides design/build requests autonomously so Jon's inbox is never the bottleneck.
design_request_loop.escalation: Exo's call on design review → escalate to Lizi for judgment calls → escalate to Jon ONLY for critical impact or anything that could affect Exo's own functionality/security.
design_request_loop.isolation: Exo generates in the fenced capstone sandbox (spaceavailable-site/ + capstone-tools/) only — never Exos prod/CRM/ERP/MC internals. Every artifact is a reviewed, reversible diff; PR-gated deploy to the static site.
design_request_loop.students: Students REQUEST; Exo GENERATES; humans REVIEW; isolated DEPLOY. No shell/exec on Exos systems.

hosting.dns_owner: Lizi has full domain/DNS rights (Jon grants registrar access); Exo gives exact steps + stands up the host.

individual_contribution.eligibility_threshold: Material contributor = individual score >= 60/100 (scored in their track) AND affirmed by BOTH Edwin and Exos, role-aware. Below that OR not affirmed = not eligible for the launch trip or 1U content.
individual_contribution.role_fair_principle: CONTRIBUTION IS ROLE-FAIR. Dedicating fully to the website/pipeline build (or creative, or analytics/ops) is an EQUAL, unpenalized path to eligibility — no student is required to do outreach marketing. Each person is scored in the currency of THEIR track, and Edwin + Exos assess material contribution WITHIN that role. Enabling work (a converting site, a tool the team relies on) counts as fully as booked pipeline.

team_1u_payload_reward.individual_eligibility: ONLY materially-contributing members (per individual_contribution, affirmed by Edwin + Exos) may place a small item. Non-contributors are NOT allowed to place anything.
team_1u_payload_reward.content_constraints: All items: ≤1 kg total, fit the 1U volume, flight-safe materials per the PUG, export-safe (no ITAR). Any use of Exos/Armadillo marks on sold items is gated by Lizi/Exos.
team_1u_payload_reward.mass_note: The 1U payload contents must weigh NO MORE THAN 1 kg total.
team_1u_payload_reward.use_determination: The eligible (participating) team members decide the use of the payload — e.g., engraved dog tags / names, sticker or flown-item sales, or other creative. estimated_cost.assumptions: ~10–12 students; drive from DFW to Spaceport America NM (~700 mi/~12 hr each way); ~4-night launch window + travel; group lodging in Truth or Consequences, men/women separate; students are Exos's launch guests (no viewing-ticket cost). Firms up with the roster.

expense_model.method: Virtual Divvy (Bill Spend & Expense) cards issued per trip-ELIGIBLE student — NOT a flat per-diem.
expense_model.cap: Up to $55/person/day for ACTUAL, receipted expenses (food/incidentals). Pay real expenses, not a flat rate someone could pocket.
expense_model.workflow: Students use the NATIVE Divvy (Bill Spend & Expense) app — download it, transact on the virtual card, and submit receipts/expense reports IN THE DIVVY APP. No need to replicate/build an expense model in Mission Control; the Divvy app IS the corporate expense experience (even more real). Lizi/finance review + approve in Bill/Divvy; Exobot need not host it.
expense_model.card_controls: Per-card daily limit ($55) + trip-total cap; food/incidentals merchant categories; issued only to eligible travelers; activated for the trip window; auto-freeze/expire after the trip.
expense_model.central_costs: Van + lodging booked and paid CENTRALLY by Exos (not on student cards). Student cards cover food/incidentals only.
expense_model.verify: Confirm with Divvy/Bill: (1) non-employee/student cardholder eligibility + KYC; (2) accountable-plan structure so receipted reimbursements are NOT taxable income / no 1099; (3) all students 18+.
expense_model.supersedes: Replaces the flat $55/day per-diem assumption used in the cost estimate (actual spend likely averages below $55, so this also trims cost).
expense_model.food_only_gating: HARD GATE at point of sale: restrict each virtual card by Merchant Category Code to FOOD ONLY — restaurants, fast food, and grocery/food stores. Non-food swipes (apparel, gift/novelty shops, memorabilia, general retail) are DECLINED automatically. So the card itself enforces the policy; they cannot buy T-shirts or souvenirs with the funds.
expense_model.accountability_assessment: Each student submits their OWN expense reports (receipts, categorization, on-time). How they handle it — timeliness, completeness, accuracy, policy compliance — is OBSERVED and feeds their individual evaluation (professional-behavior / consistency track). A real accountability test: 'see how they do with that.'
expense_model.gating_summary: Two layers: (1) card MCC controls enforce food-only at the register; (2) mandatory individual expense reports test personal accountability and are assessed.
expense_model.issuance_at_kickoff: Virtual Divvy cards are issued to EVERYONE at the on-site kickoff (the Exos site visit) as a deliberate briefing moment — each student physically receives and HOLDS a company card and keeps it through to the launch (est. April 2027). ~8 months of ownership.
expense_model.activation_gate: Cards stay INACTIVE (zero spend possible) until BOTH (1) the launch window is set AND (2) the student is BOOKED for the trip. A student who does not become eligible (material contribution) simply never has their card activated — issuing to all preserves the experiential intent without breaking the eligibility gate.
expense_model.briefing_intent: Part of the kickoff briefing: students walk away feeling the physical responsibility of holding a company credit card and 'having a job' — and they carry that responsibility for months until it activates. A standing motivator.

rewards_eligibility_CLEAR: PERFECTLY CLEAR: anyone who does NOT materially participate (as determined by Edwin + Exos) will NOT go on the launch trip AND will NOT be allowed to place any item in the 1U payload. Participation is the price of both rewards. Two rungs: 75 kg booked → 1U payload (eligible members place items); 100 kg booked → launch trip (eligible members travel).

total_exos_contribution.purpose: Show the full Exos investment in a successful project (mirrors putting a price on the payload).
total_exos_contribution.in_kind_value_substantial: EXO3 platform + AI agent-fleet access, Exo's code-gen/build time, brand assets + media, CEO + BD team time (3–4 hr site visit + weekly touch), and the contracted Payload Sales Engineer opportunity for top performers. Materially exceeds the hard-dollar rewards.
total_exos_contribution.headline: ~$16,100 in direct rewards for a successful project, on top of significant in-kind platform, mentorship, and a real job pathway.

scope_simplification: No MC expense-submission build needed — Divvy/Bill natively handles cards + receipts + reports (Jon, 2026-08-16). Students' scoped MC area stays board/tracker only.
